A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate. A thoracic surgeon from the university hospital sits in the county lung meeting every week and gives a second opinion before a stage I-II patient is refused surgery. Counties without their own thoracic surgeon decide about surgery without one today.
supported_en: The Lau 2013 English audit study reports resection rates of 20.0% at hospitals where surgeons were based against 11.6% at peripheral hospitals, with the largest gains in units that added thoracic surgeons.
not_supported_en: The pages read do not measure the gain in curative-intent treatment from a surgeon second opinion alone, so the assumed 1.2 points is not confirmed.
in_use_quote: Erikoislääkärit (keuhkolääkäri, syöpälääkäri, keuhkokirurgi, patologi ja radiologi) suunnittelevat hoidon juuri sinun tilanteeseen sopivaksi eli tekevät yksilöllisen hoitosuunnitelman.
missing_en: No page shows that a thoracic surgeon reviews every Kainuu decision not to operate, either at a weekly county meeting or by checking that all Kainuu stage I-II patients go to the OYS meeting.
summary_en: The OYS lung cancer care-pathway page says the university hospital is responsible for lung cancer team meetings. In these meetings a lung surgeon, a lung physician, an oncologist, a pathologist and a radiologist make each patient's treatment plan. The same page says OYS gives the surgery and radiotherapy, and Kainuu's own site lists thoracic surgery among its specialties. The English audit study we already hold (Lau 2013) found resection rates of 20.0% at hospitals where surgeons were based against 11.6% at peripheral hospitals, and the largest gains in units that added thoracic surgeons. It is observational and does not measure the effect of a surgeon second opinion on its own.
unanswered_en: I found no Kainuu or OYS page saying whether Kainuu holds its own lung cancer meeting or whether a thoracic surgeon attends it.
